local_articles.title: Defending St Jude champ Justin Rose, 46, still pushing to stay ‘elite’
local_articles.snippet: Nobody on the PGA Tour has been particularly surprised that Justin Rose has continued to win golf tournaments well into his 40s. The Englishman arrives at the FedEx Cup play-off opener, the FedEx St Jude Championship, as the defending champion after defeating J.J. Spaun in a play-off in 2025. Rose, now 46, followed that win last summer with his second victory at the Farmers Insurance Open since 2019, a seven-stroke runaway at the famed Torrey Pines. “Obviously been around a long time, had a great career. questions.title: Which club will win the 2026 FA Community Shield?
questions.background: The FA Community Shield is English football's traditional curtain-raiser ahead of the domestic league season.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : The Football Association's official match result or reliable contemporaneous reporting of the result. Resolution Condition : Resolve to the club that wins the 2026 FA Community Shield, including a victory by penalty shootout if applicable. Accepted Answer Format : The winning club's name.
questions.current_reasoning: Recalibrating the Aug 16 Cardiff FA Community Shield from stale July 23 54/46 to market-consensus 51/49 based on Aug 9-11 multi-book odds and squad/preseason updates (The Fair Stake/Ladbrokes, Record.pt/Betclic/Solverde/Lebull, talkSPORT Aug 10; Sports Mole Aug 9; Betway, Hindustan Times, local Khaleej Times/Straits Times/Al Jazeera Aug 9-11): Four sportsbooks converge almost identically on a coin-flip trophy market—Ladbrokes 90-min odds 6/4 Arsenal, 5/2 Draw, 13/8 Man City de-vig to 50.9% Arsenal / 49.1% City (assuming 50/50 straight-to-penalties shootout, where 6 of the last 10 Community Shields were decided; 50.4%/49.6% with slight Donnarumma shootout edge), with Lebull (50.8%), Betclic (51.3%), and Solverde (50.0%) averaging 50.7% Arsenal. Team news explains the narrowing: although Arsenal completed the GBP 75m signing of Bruno Guimaraes (Aug 8) and welcome David Raya/Bukayo Saka back to training ahead of Wednesday's Como friendly, Arteta confirmed Aug 9 that BOTH William Saliba (back, 2-week complete rest) and Jurrien Timber (groin, 'still weeks away') are OUT, and Arsenal conceded 6 goals in back-to-back friendly losses (3-1 Betis Aug 5, 3-2 Borussia Dortmund Aug 9). Meanwhile, despite Rodri missing out (back surgery) and Haaland/Anderson/Guehi/O'Reilly/Doku returning to training only Wednesday Aug 12, Enzo Maresca's City finished their Asia tour sharply with a 3-1 win over Atletico Madrid in Seoul (Aug 9, Omar Marmoush brace, Antoine Semenyo 2 assists). Trimming Arsenal 0.54 -> 0.51 and lifting Manchester City 0.46 -> 0.49.

local_articles.title: Manchester City's Anderson eager to repay record fee with silverware
local_articles.snippet: 12 - Manchester City's new signing Elliot Anderson said he is determined to justify his hefty transfer fee and hopes to make an immediate impact when the FA Cup winners face Premier League champions Arsenal in Sunday's Community Shield. The 23-year-old joined City from Nottingham Forest in July in a deal British media reported could rise to 116 million pounds ($156.66 million), making him the second-most expensive British player. "I'm over the moon," Anderson told reporters on Wednesday after his first training session under new manager Enzo Maresca. "The lads have welcomed me really well and training went well." The England international could make his debut against Arsenal just days after arriving at the club. questions.title: Who will be appointed to succeed Pape Thiaw as head coach of Senegal's men's national football team by August 31, 2026?
questions.background: The Senegalese Football Federation is responsible for appointing the national team's head coach.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : An official announcement by the Senegalese Football Federation, as confirmed by contemporaneous reliable news reporting. Resolution : Resolve to the person publicly announced as Pape Thiaw's successor between August 1 and August 31, 2026. The resolution date is the date the appointment is publicly announced, rather than the coach's presentation or first match. Accepted Answer Format : The appointed coach's full name.
questions.current_reasoning: Key 2026-08-08 update (SenePlus citing Mercato360 Aug 6 exclusive): negotiations between Senegal's FSF and Patrick Vieira have accelerated sharply toward an 'Horizon 2030' four-year project. Resolving earlier Aug 4 doubts from L'Observateur that Vieira preferred club football and had not met FSF formally, emissaries in Dakar convinced Vieira to give his green light ('feu vert') to formal negotiations; FSF President Abdoulaye Fall personally validated Vieira as the federation's 'absolute priority target' despite minor internal dissent, and super-agent Meissa Ndiaye is negotiating final salary and technical staff details with principle reportedly agreed. Respecting the <=0.55 anti-overconfidence ceiling for unconfirmed appointments (salary/staff terms and Pape Thiaw's severance dispute with the Ministry of Sports remain unresolved), nudge Patrick Vieira 0.53 -> 0.55. Trim Omar Daf 0.20 -> 0.16 as clearly behind Vieira on the shortlist (and currently Congo assistant) and Habib Beye 0.07 -> 0.06, while nudging DTN Souleymane Diallo 0.08 -> 0.10 as the explicitly named September interim fallback if Thiaw's ministerial severance deadlock drags past late August. Hold Malick Daf at 0.02 (sum = 0.89, 11% residual).

questions.title: Which broad demand component will contribute most to Japan's quarter-on-quarter GDP growth in April–June 2026?
questions.background: Japan's Cabinet Office publishes quarterly GDP estimates, including a breakdown of demand components' contributions to growth.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Cabinet Office's August 2026 release of Japan's April–June 2026 GDP estimates. Use that release's figures rather than subsequent revisions. Resolution Date : 2026-08-17 Accepted Answer Format : Resolve to the top-level demand component with the largest percentage-point contribution to Japan's quarter-on-quarter GDP growth for April–June 2026. Answer with the component's standard name.
questions.current_reasoning: Major consensus shift from the Aug 7, 2026 Reuters poll of 15 economists (CNA) ahead of the Cabinet Office's Aug 17 preliminary Q2 (April-June) GDP release: median real GDP growth is now forecast at +0.5% QoQ (+2.0% annualized), with net external demand (Net exports) contributing +0.3 percentage points — driven by a sharp drop in mineral fuel imports amid Middle East/Hormuz disruptions plus stronger service exports — which implies Domestic demand contributes +0.2 percentage points (repeating Q1 2026's +0.3 pp net exports vs +0.2 pp domestic demand pattern). Although private consumption (+0.5% QoQ, ~+0.27 pp) and capex (+0.4% QoQ, ~+0.06 pp) create genuine upside risk for Domestic demand (keeping Domestic demand strong at 0.34), Net exports not only leads on the median headline-minus-external arithmetic (+0.3 pp vs +0.2 pp) but is also invariant across both the Cabinet Office's 2-way (Domestic demand vs Net exports) and 3-way (Private demand vs Public demand vs Net exports) broad demand breakdowns. Raising Net exports sharply 0.28 -> 0.45, trimming Domestic demand 0.41 -> 0.34, Private demand 0.15 -> 0.09, Private consumption 0.07 -> 0.05, and Public demand 0.04 -> 0.02 (leaving 5% residual for inventory/investment/naming edge cases).

questions.current_reasoning: The March 17, 2026 draw placed England (#4 FIH), India (#8), Pakistan (#12), and Wales into Men's Pool D, with all matches at Wagener Stadium in Amstelveen, Netherlands (Aug 15-19).
